Class PlayerDraftState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.game.PlayerDraftState
public class PlayerDraftState extends Object
Tracks the standard card draw quotas of players during a round.

After all players have placed their totems, the board knows how many cards each player may draw from the upper row and from the lower row. This class stores those numbers and consumes them one card at a time.

This class deliberately knows only the draw quotas. It does not know:

  • which player is the current player;
  • which cards are present on the board;
  • whether a specific card is drawable;
  • when a player must return to the starting tile;
  • who is allowed to perform an extra draw.

Extra draws are not tracked here because they do not consume the standard upper-row and lower-row quotas.

    • startCardSelection

      public void startCardSelection(Player player)
      Starts the card-selection phase for a player.

      The player must already have both upper-row and lower-row quotas registered. A quota can be zero, but the entry must exist because it means the board has already resolved that player's totem space.

      Parameters:
      player - player who is about to choose cards

    • consumeChoice

      public void consumeChoice(Player player, CardRow cardRow)
      Consumes one standard draw choice from the selected row.

      If the player has no choices left after this consumption, the state returns to DraftTurnState.TURN_COMPLETED.

      Parameters:
      player - player who has just drawn a card
      cardRow - row from which the card was drawn
